newsitem.title: POLAND: WARTA SHORTENS ISSUE SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD.
newsitem.headline: WARTA SHORTENS ISSUE SUBSCRIPTION PERIOD.

text.p: Polish insurer TUiR Warta SA has brought forward the end of the subscription period for up to 2.6 million shares earmarked for three banks and two current shareholders to February 24, Warta said in a Monday statement.
Warta had earlier set the end of the subscription period for between 865,380 and 2,596,139 shares for February 28.

The new shares are earmarked for Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy SA (BPH), Kredyt Bank SA, Powszechny Bank Kredytowy SA, Kulczyk Holding SA and an individual investor, Anna Wozniak. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
